            '\n'
            '  Future<void> _continue() async {\n'
            '    _purchaseAttemptedThisSession = true;\n'
            '    _recordAttribution(\n'
            '      PaywallAttributionEventType.purchaseStarted,\n'
            '      suggestionStage:\n'

            '    if (package == null) {\n'

            '        const SnackBar(content: Text(SubscriptionCopy.paywallNoOfferings)),\n'

            '    setState(() {});\n'
            '\n'
            '    RevenueFunnelAnalytics.paywallPurchaseCtaTapped(\n'
            '      source: _attributionSource.id,\n'
            '      isPro: _ps.entitlements?.isPro == true,\n'

            '      period: period,\n'

            '    try {\n'
            '      final ent = await _paywallController.purchaseSelectedPackage();\n'

            '      if (ent.isPro) {\n'

            '        _recordAttribution(\n'
            '          PaywallAttributionEventType.purchaseCompleted,\n'

            '        await First25UserMetrics.trackPaywallPurchased(\n'
            '          surface: \'paywall_screen\',\n'
            '          period: period,\n'

            '          const SnackBar(content: Text(ArchivePaywallCopy.purchaseSuccess)),\n'

            '          content: Text(\n'
            '            userFacingErrorMessage(\n'

            '              fallback: \'Purchase could not be completed.\',\n'

            '          ),\n'
            '        ),\n'

            '\n'
            '  RestorePurchasesFlow get _effectiveRestoreFlow =>\n'

            '      ));\n'

            '  Future<void> _restore() async {\n'

            '\n'
            '    final flow = _effectiveRestoreFlow;\n'
